text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
She has total command over her body. What 
extraordinary talent for a performer!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Aha! We might be able to use that stage 
set too... I'll go check with the tech 
crew!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching <chrname>'s training seemed to serve as 
tremendous inspiration for her.
